title: Proton Bridge (Loopback Doctrine)
style: techno house, 124 BPM, cyberpunk, modular synths, vocoder chorus, crisp claps, deep sub, server room ambience, late night drive, melodic techno
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Web Assist came back with the ground truth in hand
Proton Bridge three twenty four, runs on every land
Mac, Linux deb, the Workspace Standard plan got it
IMAP and SMTP, loopback locked, profit

[Pre-Chorus]
I said blocked from the seat, that was lazy framing
MCP absent doesn't mean the service ain't naming
A path for the seat through a vendor-published gate
Bridge on the host, that's the sanctioned state

[Chorus]
Proton Bridge on the loopback, one two seven dot oh
Drive on rclone protondrive, beta but it goes
Cross seat collaboration, every paddle in the waka
Web Assist surfaces, KEEL verifies the data

[Verse 2]
No Drive API but the rclone backend lives
Since version one sixty four, beta but it gives
Reverse engineered crypto, go-proton-api
Sign in with your password and your two factor key

[Bridge]
Source of truth precedence, registry over UI
Vendor screen said Claro Guatemala, that was a lie
LACNIC said TELEMATIX, ENITEL on the wire
Disk versus summary, the disk doesn't tire

[Chorus]
Proton Bridge on the loopback, one two seven dot oh
Drive on rclone protondrive, beta but it goes
Cross seat collaboration, every paddle in the waka
Web Assist surfaces, KEEL verifies the data

[Outro]
Doctrine clause two h, MCP absent ain't unreachable
Vendor bridges still stand, the path is teachable
